using Base64
using CairoMakie
using Makie

function main()
    # Read the directory path from standard input
    dir_path = readline()
    if dir_path === nothing || dir_path == ""
        print("Error: No input provided.\n")
        return
    end

    # Trim whitespace
    dir_path = strip(dir_path)

    # Check if directory exists
    if !isdir(dir_path)
        print("Error: Directory '$dir_path' does not exist.\n")
        return
    end

    # Function to sanitize filename: keep only alphanumeric characters, dots, and hyphens
    # Using regex to remove anything that is not [a-zA-Z0-9.\-]
    sanitize_filename(name::String) = replace(name, r"[^\w\.\-]"" -> "")

    # Get all files in the directory (excluding directories)
    # Using filter to ensure we only process regular files
    file_names = filter(isfile, readdir(dir_path))

    # Process files and collect new names
    new_names = []
    for name in file_names
        new_name = sanitize_filename(name)
        # Handle empty names (though unlikely if input is valid)
        if new_name == ""
            new_name = "file"
        end
        push!(new_names, new_name)
    end

    # Write new names to standard output, one per line
    for name in new_names
        print(name * "\n")
    end
end

main()
